verdict.rationale: Calendly's pricing page lists an "Always free" Free plan that includes one-on-one scheduling and a customizable booking page, and signup needs no credit card. That is a usable individual booking link with no paid plan. Community reports add real caveats: the free plan limits meeting configurations (users say they effectively must pay to cover personal use too), and at least one feature was moved off the free tier. missing for 10: documented specifics of free-tier limits (number of event types, calendar connections), explicit confirmation that calendar conflict-checking is included on Free, and independent hands-on corroboration that the free tier is sufficient long-term.
